questions.stem: How are auxins used as selective weedkillers?

options.text: They kill all plants they come into contact with
They cause broad-leaved weeds to grow uncontrollably and die, without affecting narrow-leaved crops like grass
They prevent weed seeds from germinating
They attract insects that eat the weeds

questions.explanation: Synthetic auxins act as selective weedkillers because broad-leaved weeds absorb more of the chemical than narrow-leaved crops. The auxin causes the weeds to grow too rapidly, disrupting their development and killing them.
